required_capabilities: Create Slab Type (×1); Create Slab (×1); Inspect Project (×1); Query Materials (×1)
instruction: Two steps: (1) create a new floor type with a timber parquet finish based on the provided section view; (2) create one floor slab on the active storey using this floor type, covering the entire footprint of the existing exterior walls, flush with the walls' outer surface, tracing the outline from the live model, and placed so its TOP surface sits at the storey level. Do not create or modify any walls; only create the new floor type and the one slab.
